claims: Coachella 2026 Weekend 2 takes place at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California.
Coachella 2026 Weekend 2 is headlined by Justin Bieber, Sabrina Carpenter, and Karol G.
As of April 12, 2026, Coachella 2026 Weekend 2 is the only confirmed 2026 performance for Justin Bieber.
Tickets for Coachella 2026 Weekend 2 are sold out officially via Coachella.com.
Tickets for Coachella 2026 Weekend 2 are available on resale sites like AXS and StubHub.
General admission for Coachella 2026 Weekend 2 started at $549.
Outstanding in the Field offers 4-course dinners in the VIP area for each night of Coachella 2026 Weekend 2.
